notes.title: Version 1.0.6 already updated
notes.notes:
We have just updated version 1.0.6. This update won't affect the exist replay file.
This update will download the entire game content (486MB) because we reorganized the game files. Incremental updates will be more convenient in the future.

Update:

[olist]
 improve the text display of the Ending screen
 Staff screen supports fast-forward and skip
 add game data recovery,  and you can change the number of auto backup files
 fix the unlock condition of Last SpellCard in practice mode
 add German and French translation, and revise some text problems in Japanese and English
 preload some game resources to reduce the loading time when switching stages
 the replay file will stores the game version and can be viewed through the Replay screen
 try to fix the black screen problem (I hope it's really been fixed)
 Improve the efficiency of the game script
 update Steam SDK
[/olist]

Happy children's day!

notes.title: The release of original soundtrack has been postponed to May 1
notes.notes:
Because the OST is still under review, the OST was not released on time.
We decided to postpone the release date to ,May 1st at 6:00.
Thank you for your support. Please be patient.
We have uploaded the normal quality music to Netease Cloud Music and Bilibili, welcome to listen!
